scope: Provisional-ID agentic question planning from permitted versioned inventory metadata. Original fixture/answer content is not used.

source.inspection_limit: Question proposals use the inventory endpoint-stage review; original full prompt, output and method limits remain attached. No new runtime or source-data validation implied.

defaults.authoring_unit: One coherent question on independently observed biological inputs; combine bookkeeping and component summaries into its connected analysis.
defaults.required_before_implementation: Freeze independent source lineage, biological sample structure, exact input boundary, method versions, complete artifact schemas and deterministic acceptance. Keep corpus train-only and expected solve time <=30 minutes.
defaults.native_reference: Reference scripts execute the actual required packages; private oracles read supplied inputs. Independently verify identities, algebraic invariants and all required artifacts. No LLM-as-a-judge.
defaults.learned_output_acceptance: Grade complete finite predictions against private observed labels with a frozen metric/criterion. Accept equivalent cluster/topic label permutations. Model uncertainty and counterfactual claims require endpoint-specific checks.
defaults.runtime_boundary: For long original pipelines, explicitly choose a bounded observed-data start boundary. Precomputed alignments or counts cover downstream analysis only; do not claim full raw-data pipeline coverage. GPU/weight-dependent methods and large reference resources remain feasibility questions.
defaults.consolidation: Review overlaps with earlier question cards before implementation. Distinct assays, statistical estimands and named native methods cannot be silently substituted.

questions.scientific_question: Which distal regulatory differences remain after controlled peak calling, replicate normalization, motif analysis and promoter/blacklist/CNV checks?
required_endpoint_stages: exclude promoter, blacklist and CNV effects
observed_input_requirements: Observed ATAC fragments or BAMs, biological replicates, peak regions, matching annotation and frozen motif models.
Observed ChIP/CUT&Tag reads with biological replicates, controls, matched genome/annotation; observed contact matrices for contact questions.
source_specific_decisions: Control background and coordinate conventions must be explicit.
Control sequence composition and define motif equivalence.
Resolve overlapping feature classes, transcript multiplicity, distance sign and ties.
Use biological replicates and raw counts; preserve effect direction and tested universe.
Nearest genes are annotations, not established enhancer targets. Declare the consensus and spike-in conventions.
proposed_artifact_requirements: BAM/fragment QC, BED peaks, count matrices, motif matches/backgrounds, gene links and sample-level effects
Signal/control QC, native BED/bigWig or contact matrices, region counts, full differential results and gene context
deterministic_verifier_design: Run native peak/motif tools; independently check intervals, fragment counts, background selection, matched sample joins and multiplicity.
Native package reference, independent interval/count/normalization checks and explicit background; distinguish occupancy from regulatory causation.

questions.scientific_question: Which gene-level screen effects remain after observed guide-count QC, negative controls, replicate aggregation and multiplicity correction?
observed_input_requirements: Observed guide counts before/after perturbation, biological replicates, guide-to-gene map, controls and frozen pathways.
Frozen public target, genetics, dependency, expression and compound evidence; measured effects with tissue, direction and release metadata.
source_specific_decisions: This begins at supplied guide effects; it does not exercise screen normalization or inference.
A ranking of supplied scores does not establish differential essentiality.
Review the biological replication unit; guide-level pooling must not silently replace replicate-aware inference.
proposed_artifact_requirements: Guide eligibility and counts, normalization, guide and gene effects, control diagnostics, complete pathway results
Identifier/release map, source evidence rows, direction/effect tables, confounder checks, ranked candidates and uncertainty flags
deterministic_verifier_design: Run the actual screen package; independently verify joins, guide aggregation, normalization controls and full ranked outputs; guide observations are not biological replicates.
Independent joins and declared ranking arithmetic; check evidence direction and source provenance; preserve conflicting/absent evidence rather than generating narrative ground truth.

questions.scientific_question: Which assembly contiguity, proposed joins and error summaries are supported by observed contigs and aligned-read evidence?
required_endpoint_stages: join aligned base totals and mismatches
observed_input_requirements: Observed short/long reads with source identities; independently supported reference or taxonomic evidence when evaluating correctness.
source_specific_decisions: Contiguity does not establish sequence accuracy or completeness.
Candidate scores do not establish that a join is biologically valid.
Declare the aligned-base denominator and unaligned sequence policy.
proposed_artifact_requirements: FASTA, FASTQ QC, contig metrics, alignments, coverage, taxonomic evidence and repeat/read support
deterministic_verifier_design: Native assembly/classification reference with independent contiguity and coverage arithmetic; N50 alone does not establish correct assembly or taxonomy.

questions.scientific_question: Which observed long reads retain support after length, extended-CIGAR and indel-error accounting?
required_endpoint_stages: accumulate matches, mismatches, indels and clipping
observed_input_requirements: Observed short/long reads with source identities; independently supported reference or taxonomic evidence when evaluating correctness.
source_specific_decisions: Read N50 and mean use different weighting.
Keep event counts distinct from affected bases.
Soft clipping is not an aligned-base error; ordinary M operations cannot distinguish matches and mismatches.
proposed_artifact_requirements: FASTA, FASTQ QC, contig metrics, alignments, coverage, taxonomic evidence and repeat/read support
deterministic_verifier_design: Native assembly/classification reference with independent contiguity and coverage arithmetic; N50 alone does not establish correct assembly or taxonomy.

questions.scientific_question: Which observed metabolite effects remain after intensity normalization, replicate-aware contrasts and multiple testing?
observed_input_requirements: Observed concentration/time response with biological replicates, plate positions, controls and measurement units.
Observed intensity/count matrices with sample, batch, replicate, missingness, feature identity and assay metadata; matched modalities for cross-omics claims.
source_specific_decisions: Use observed assay values and explicit handling of missing or censored intensities.
Ranking supplied means does not establish statistical significance.
Preserve replicates and specify missingness, zeros and the statistical model.
proposed_artifact_requirements: Plate/sample maps, raw and normalized responses, control diagnostics, fitted curves/uncertainty and complete hit decisions
Feature/sample joins, normalized measurements, missingness masks, complete effects, pathways and matched associations
deterministic_verifier_design: Independent normalization and model-prediction residuals; actual curve fitting; observed replicate units and multiple-testing rules; no invented response points.
Independent joins and model contrasts; native numerical reference with censored/missing values preserved; mediation is a model assumption, not automatic causality.

questions.scientific_question: Which observed methylation differences remain after CpG eligibility and per-sample coverage checks?
required_endpoint_stages: derive fractions from methylated and total reads
observed_input_requirements: Observed methylated/unmethylated read counts and expression from matched samples, with array probe or genomic coordinates and assembly version.
source_specific_decisions: Distinguish site-weighted and coverage-weighted summaries.
A large shift alone does not establish differential methylation.
Keep coverage and biological replication distinct; justify the statistical model for fractions.
proposed_artifact_requirements: Coverage/QC tables, locus and region effects, probe/assembly mapping, matched expression joins and full association tests
deterministic_verifier_design: Independent proportion and interval arithmetic; native model plus full coverage/missingness checks; do not infer paired measurements from shared labels.

questions.scientific_question: Which transcript/protein effects and pathways agree after observed feature identity, scale and direction reconciliation?
observed_input_requirements: Observed intensity/count matrices with sample, batch, replicate, missingness, feature identity and assay metadata; matched modalities for cross-omics claims.
source_specific_decisions: Across-gene association is not a patient-level causal relationship.
A combined magnitude score can hide opposite effect directions.
A minimum-signal proxy does not establish a biochemical bottleneck or pathway activation.
proposed_artifact_requirements: Feature/sample joins, normalized measurements, missingness masks, complete effects, pathways and matched associations
deterministic_verifier_design: Independent joins and model contrasts; native numerical reference with censored/missing values preserved; mediation is a model assumption, not automatic causality.

questions.scientific_question: Which observed population differences remain after genotype eligibility, allele-frequency, equilibrium and sample-outlier checks?
required_endpoint_stages: join allele frequencies and sample sizes
derive allele frequencies from genotype counts
observed_input_requirements: Observed VCF/BCF and population/pedigree metadata with missingness, ploidy and release-aware allele definitions.
source_specific_decisions: Pin the estimator and locus aggregation; unequal population sizes matter.
Align reference/alternate alleles before comparing frequencies.
State exact versus asymptotic testing and rare-genotype handling.
Specify missingness, scaling and PCA sign equivalence; outliers are not automatically erroneous samples.
proposed_artifact_requirements: VCF/BCF/TBI, genotype/sample eligibility, allele counts, PCA/frequency statistics, haplotypes and pedigree checks
deterministic_verifier_design: Independent allele/ploidy/missingness counts; pinned statistical methods; native bcftools/PLINK-style operation with full result checks.

questions.scientific_question: Which observed protein-abundance effects remain after assay-scale reconciliation, normalization and replicated comparisons?
observed_input_requirements: Observed concentration/time response with biological replicates, plate positions, controls and measurement units.
Observed intensity/count matrices with sample, batch, replicate, missingness, feature identity and assay metadata; matched modalities for cross-omics claims.
source_specific_decisions: Use observed assay values and explicit missing-intensity handling.
Ranking supplied means does not establish statistical significance.
Handle missingness and detection limits explicitly; preserve biological replicates.
proposed_artifact_requirements: Plate/sample maps, raw and normalized responses, control diagnostics, fitted curves/uncertainty and complete hit decisions
Feature/sample joins, normalized measurements, missingness masks, complete effects, pathways and matched associations
deterministic_verifier_design: Independent normalization and model-prediction residuals; actual curve fitting; observed replicate units and multiple-testing rules; no invented response points.
Independent joins and model contrasts; native numerical reference with censored/missing values preserved; mediation is a model assumption, not automatic causality.

questions.scientific_question: Which observed spatial-expression and cell-composition patterns persist across explicit tissue regions and coordinate summaries?
required_endpoint_stages: define tissue center and distance groups
observed_input_requirements: Observed spatial coordinates, counts, image/segmentation metadata and multiple sections or samples where comparisons require replication.
source_specific_decisions: A spatial gradient is descriptive unless the dependence structure is modeled.
Geometric center is a chosen spatial statistic, not an anatomical niche definition.
Preserve tissue/sample identity and distinguish supplied labels from inferred clusters.
Coordinate quadrants are geometric regions; they need biological justification before being called tissue niches.
proposed_artifact_requirements: Coordinate transforms, segmentation/QC masks, H5AD, region/cell expression tables, neighborhood edges and null distributions
deterministic_verifier_design: Check physical units, section boundaries, segmentation-to-cell joins, geometric distances and full null-model outputs; compare images through underlying numerical artifacts.
